source_scope: official challenge page, pinned Apache-2.0 baseline repository, HF repository metadata, dataset README/field schema, and pack index; no data pack, record, audio, video, or checkpoint payload fetched

task_fit.track1_task1: audio prefix plus assistant instructions; choose one of four actions and submit JSON; Top-1 evaluation
task_fit.track2: separate online audio-visual and audio-only proactive understanding subtracks; JSON output for every stream chunk, including no-response chunks
task_fit.decision_relevance: high for action selection, abstain/wait, and response timing; AV track is not a fixed-option offline probability benchmark

license.dataset_specific_terms: not separately stated in the inspected challenge dataset README or challenge page
license.speaker_consent_and_privacy_terms: not established in the inspected materials

limitations: The task shape is unusually close to typed Decision JSON, but dataset and underlying media usage rights are unresolved
The challenge website's requirement to use open-source datasets/models is not a dataset-specific license grant
The Apache-2.0 code/model-repository labels were not treated as independent proof of source-media rights or consent
The AV track is online event-response evaluation and does not itself define a calibrated fixed-option probability task
Source-level independence, speaker overlap, and label provenance were not verified from data records
The AV development partition is one 9.28 GB shard, larger than available local storage; the full release is about 599.83 GB
